response.overview: Mark and Evelien are the young parents of a very healthy son. Ten fingers, ten toes, all the trimmings, but the sunny outlook is missing. In a world where appearances rule, they have forgotten reality. Life and love are not always fun and the grind lurks like a predator. During eight uncomfortable walks, they try to find out where they took the wrong turn and whether it is even possible to end up on the right path next to each other.
response.title: Walk In The Park
